shots.title: We Did It
shots.subtitle: We actually did it.
shots.action: The friends catch their breath beside the defeated robot.
shots.sound_suggestion: A final motor wind-down, then a relieved breath.

shots.title: The Barber Returns
shots.subtitle: I was only gone a minute...
shots.action: The barber returns, startled by the aftermath.
shots.sound_suggestion: Door hinge, tiny comic hat pop.

shots.title: An Offer to Fix It
shots.subtitle: The barber offers to fix your hair.
shots.action: He offers the empty chair and comb.
shots.sound_suggestion: Soft comb tap; calm room tone.

shots.title: A Look Between Friends
shots.subtitle: You look at each other...
shots.action: They look at each other, considering the offer.

shots.title: No, Thanks
shots.subtitle: ...and say no.
shots.action: A shared head shake; they choose to keep their hair.
shots.sound_suggestion: A light hair swish and a tiny sparkle chime.

shots.title: Bad Hair. Good Friends.
shots.subtitle: Bad hair. Good friends.
shots.action: They leave together while the barber waves goodbye.
shots.sound_suggestion: Paired footsteps and a gentle musical resolve.
